abstract: # mTOR as Regulator of Lifespan, Aging, and Cellular Senescence: A Mini-Review. title={mTOR as Regulator of Lifespan, Aging, and Cellular Senescence: A Mini-Review},. The potential mechanisms how mTOR signaling controls lifespan and influences aging-related processes such as cellular senescence, metabolism, and stem cell function are discussed. An extensive review summarizes the most recent findings on mTOR inhibitors in the context of aging, highlighting their complex interactions with cellular systems, effect on longevity, and potential as therapeutic approaches for age-related diseases. The potential role of mTOR in the context of cellular senescence, a tumor suppressor mechanism and a pillar of aging is focused on and the opportunities to exploit senescENCE-associated mTOR functions to manipulate senescences phenotypes in age-associated diseases and cancer treatment are discussed. ### The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies: The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity-Pathway-%C5%BBerdka-Brasse/eab363237b1edd3f7029596015cf2816e1b94fde).
